cells.prompt: Explain what a local-first AI coworker app is in practical terms.
cells.answer: A local-first AI coworker app is a personal assistant that lives entirely on your device—no cloud accounts, no internet required for core tasks. It runs models and data locally, meaning your conversations and work stay private and load instantly. Think of it as a smart coworker who’s always there, never leaves your laptop or phone, and doesn’t need a network to help you write, code, research, or organize.
